prompt: Write unit tests for an Angular 21 component called `UserProfileComponent` that uses `resource()` to fetch user data from `/api/users/:id` based on a signal input. The component has: an `id` input signal, a `userResource` created with `resource()`, and displays loading/error/success states in the template. I need tests that cover: initial loading state, successful data display, error handling, and that changing the input triggers a refetch. Use Vitest and TestBed.
assertions: Uses componentRef.setInput() or fixture.componentRef.setInput() to set the id input signal
Uses await fixture.whenStable() for async change detection (not just detectChanges)
Provides a mock or spy for the HTTP/fetch dependency (vi.fn, vi.spyOn, or provider override)
Tests loading state (checks for loading indicator in DOM)
Tests successful data display (checks rendered user data)
Tests error state (simulates fetch failure and checks error display)
Tests that changing the input signal value triggers a new fetch
